units.source_text: 到了秋天，源氏公子冥想前尘，愁思萦绕。

en.t: When autumn came, Prince Genji fell into deep thought over the past, and sorrow lingered around him.

units.source_text: 回忆去年此时在夕颜家听到的嘈杂的砧声，也觉得很可恋慕。

en.t: He remembered the noisy sound of fulling blocks he had heard at Yugao's house around this time last year, and even that seemed dearly nostalgic.

units.source_text: 想起常陆亲王家那位小姐很像夕颜，便时时写信去求爱。

en.t: Thinking that the young lady in Prince Hitachi's household greatly resembled Yugao, he kept sending letters to court her.
But she still paid him no attention.

units.source_text: 难道这女子是铁石心肠么？

en.t: Could this woman really have a heart of iron and stone?

units.source_text: 源氏公子不胜愤懑，愈加不肯就此罢休了。

en.t: Prince Genji could not contain his frustration, and became still less willing to let the matter end there.

units.source_text: 便督促大辅命妇，恨恨地对她说：“到底是怎么一回事？

en.t: So he pressed Taifu no Myobu and said to her resentfully, "What on earth is going on?

units.source_text: 我有生以来不曾碰过这种钉子！”

en.t: Never in my life have I been rebuffed like this!"

units.source_text: 大辅命妇也觉得不好意思，答道：“我决不相信这段因缘真不相称。

en.t: Taifu no Myobu also felt awkward and replied, "I certainly do not believe this bond is truly unsuitable.

units.source_text: 只是这位小姐的懦怯怕羞，太过分了，什么事也不敢妄为。”

en.t: It is only that the young lady is excessively timid and shy, and she does not dare act rashly in anything."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“这是不懂得人情世故的缘故。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "That is because she does not understand human affairs or the ways of the world.

units.source_text: 倘是无知无识的幼儿，或者有人管束、自己不能做主的人，那么还有理由可说。

en.t: If she were an ignorant child, or someone under another's control who could not decide for herself, then there might be some excuse.

units.source_text: 如今这位小姐无拘无束，万事都可自作自主，所以我才写信去的。

en.t: But now this young lady is unrestrained and can decide everything for herself, which is why I wrote to her.

units.source_text: 现在我百无聊赖，寂寞难当，如果她能体谅我的心情，给我个回音，我就心满意足了。

en.t: Now I am idle and unbearably lonely; if she could understand my feelings and send me a reply, I would be fully satisfied.

units.source_text: 我并不像世间一般男子那么贪色，只要能够站在她那荒芜的邸宅的廊上就好了。

en.t: I am not as lustful as ordinary men in the world; it would be enough simply to stand on the veranda of her desolate mansion.

units.source_text: 老是这样下去，教我狐疑满腹，莫名其妙。

en.t: If things go on like this, I will be filled with suspicion and left completely bewildered.

units.source_text: 即使她本人不允许，总要请你想个法子，玉成好事。

en.t: Even if she herself will not permit it, I must ask you to think of some way to bring this matter to a happy conclusion.

units.source_text: 我决不会做出不端的行为，使你为难。”

en.t: I will certainly not behave improperly or put you in a difficult position."
